cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Hi.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I'm calling for some information about the cycle camp – I'm thinking of sending my son.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: Great.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: Well, it's held every weekday morning over the summer vacation and we focus on basic

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: cycling skills and safety. We have eight levels for children from three years upwards.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: How old's your son?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Charlie? He's seven.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: He can ride a bike, but he needs a little more training before he's safe to go on the

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: road.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: He'd probably be best in Level 5.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: They start off practising on the site here, and we aim to get them riding on the road,

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: but first they're taken to ride in the park, away from the traffic.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Right. And can you tell me a bit about the instructors?

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: Well, all our staff wear different coloured shirts.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: So, we have three supervisors, and they have red shirts.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: They support the instructors, and they also stand in for me if I'm not around.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: Then the instructors themselves are in blue shirts, and one of these is responsible for

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: each class.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: In order to be accepted, all our instructors have to submit a reference from someone

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: who's seen them work with children – like if they've worked as a babysitter, for example.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: Then they have to complete our training course, including how to do lesson plans, and

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: generally care for the well-being of the kids in their class.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: They do a great job, I have to say.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Right. And tell me a bit about the classes. What size will Charlie's class be?

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: We have a limit of eight children in each class, so their instructor really gets to know

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: them well.

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: They're out riding most of the time but they have quiet times too, where their instructor

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: might tell them a story that's got something to do with cycling, or get them to play a

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: game together. It's a lot of fun.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It must be. Now, what happens if there's rain? Do the classes still run?

cues.speaker: KE
cues.text: Oh yes. We don't let that put us off – we just put on our waterproofs and keep cycling.
